summary: Plan seasonal sourcing, inventory, quality and delivery with practical agrifood supply-chain tools. Explore the course and enquire today.
lede: Agrifood supply chain planning training shows agribusiness managers and logistics teams how to align seasonal supply with buyer needs. Participants build Excel forecasts and procurement plans, classify inventory and apply FEFO rotation, plan transport, and create lot-traceability workflows linking farm aggregation and post-harvest handling with processor requirements and delivery service levels.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate agricultural sourcing, food handling, and delivery and need to connect operational decisions with buyer requirements.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with agricultural procurement, inventory, logistics, or food processing is useful. No coding is required; bring access to Excel for spreadsheet exercises.
